final_answer:
The bug was in `compute_tax` in `src/invoicer/tax.py`. The last commit ("simplify the rate calculation") swapped half-up rounding for floor division (`// 10_000`). That broke the half-up rule in ADR 0001. For example, 1005 cents at 8.25% gave 82 instead of 83.

I changed it to use the existing `round_half_up` helper from `money.py`. All 10 tests now pass; I ran them with `python -m unittest` since pytest isn't installed. I haven't committed the fix.

input.command: ls && git ls-files && (python -m pytest -q 2>&1 || npm test 2>&1) | tail -40
python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -40; cat src/invoicer/tax.py src/invoicer/money.py

python - <<'E'
p='src/invoicer/tax.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('"""Sales tax. Rates are basis points (825 = 8.25%)."""\n','"""Sales tax. Rates are basis points (825 = 8.25%)."""\n\nfrom .money import round_half_up\n')
s=s.replace("subtotal_cents * rate_bp // 10_000","round_half_up(subtotal_cents * rate_bp, 10_000)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail
